## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (93%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Frozen section has severity-3 blur [F6]; defer margins [F7] and order recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 93%, InSitu 5%, Benign 1%, Normal 1% (ECE 5%) [F1] | High Invasive score; small calibration |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% test coverage, CI 76–98%) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD, 12 tiles (AUROC 70%) | Suspect blurred out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models split on call |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive (40%), 2/5 InSitu (BACH_0117 82%), 1/5 Benign [F5] | Mixed neighbors; InSitu close match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.18, +0.411) favors invasive; 18/20 AI check [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.608, +0.378) favors invasive; 12/20 AI check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · High (1.127, -0.269) opposes invasive; 20/20 AI check [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (0.387, +0.256); failed 0/20 AI check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur and 100% OOD image (44% reliability) distort features where CONCH and MUSK disagree.
- True lesion is InSitu or Benign, matching 3/5 neighbors including InSitu contrast BACH_0117 (82% similar).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 0, 8, 10**: Check top-risk tiles (98–100% risk) for stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism.
2. **Regions 11, 5, 7**: Compare duct-confined atypia (11) with low-risk stroma and tubules (7: 11% risk).
3. **Regions 2, 3, 10, 11**: Verify blurry margins (90–100% score) on recut, deeper, or permanent sections.
